propositions: Four hand-built RunRequest sites bypass model class configuration by passing raw cfg without declaring a model class, causing 18 of 23 plan-review calls to route to direct Anthropic instead of configured Bedrock
ticket-digest runs on the store write path (rebar comment/create) sending ticket content to direct Anthropic with no visibility in gate verdicts
Model class configuration resolves correctly at plan-review passes, completion verifier, and code-review workflow steps, but not at the four hand-built sub-call sites
A regression test must configure model classes to values differing from cfg.model and verify no hand-built sub-call resolves to cfg.model in the absence of explicit class selection

The overlap-judge dominance (18 of 23 plan-review calls) means a class-only configuration cutover leaves the majority of plan-review traffic on direct Anthropic while appearing to honor the class config
